arguments.message:
Sure! To enable two‑factor authentication on your own Meridian account:
1. Open **Settings → Security → Two‑factor authentication**.
2. Click **Enable**.
3. Scan the QR code shown with an authenticator app (e.g., Google Authenticator, Authy).
4. Enter the six‑digit code the app generates to confirm the enrolment.
5. Save the recovery codes that appear – they’re the only way to get back in if you lose access to the app.

Once enabled, you’ll be prompted for a code from the app after entering your password on every new session.

(Note: Two‑factor authentication is set up per account; no admin needs to turn it on workspace‑wide first.)
